correctness.rationale: Every genus-two curve over F3 has a squarefree degree-six binary branch form, and field isomorphisms are precisely GL2(F3) substitutions. Complete 1296-form enumeration is independently checked by a closed squarefree-count formula; the exact 24-element effective group action yields Burnside sum 1656 and 69 complete disjoint orbits. Branch partitions use exact factorization. Stable Cartier rank A^2 for p=3 agrees on all 1296 forms with the degree modulo 3 of the zeta numerator computed independently from F3 and F9 point counts; 69 orbit partition checks agree with independent polynomial factorization.

value.rationale: This is a complete natural joint classification of two different torsion structures on genus-two Jacobians (Frobenius permutation of six Weierstrass points/2-torsion versus geometric 3-rank), further resolved by rational curve points. It identifies exactly which of 19 arithmetic types occur and their multiplicities; in particular all six supersingular classes lie in only three specified branch patterns, while the four-rational-branch-point type is a unique ordinary class. These restrictions and frequencies are not supplied by the known marginal counts, and make a reusable small-field testbed for arithmetic moduli and finite-field curve algorithms.
